slice: FULL SAIL Stage 1 NIGHTWATCH Ch4 Slice C1

findings.red: Canonical provisioner refused every product/staging database in FORBIDDEN_DATABASE_NAMES, including sunset_staging, before trustedPrecreated mapping/grants. Operator-approved live Sunset staging activation could not adopt an already-created worker LOGIN.
findings.green: Default refusal is preserved for sunset_staging, sunset_prod, wolfhouse_staging, wolfhouse_prod, luna_prod, and any other current_database(). allowSunsetStagingTrustedPrecreated is accepted only as an explicit spec boolean, never from env, and only when trustedPrecreated, apply, absent password, current_database()==='sunset_staging', session_user===queue table owner, existing fail-closed LOGIN, empty or exact mapping, worker kind, and caller-supplied sunset-somo binding all hold. This mode never CREATE ROLE / ALTER ROLE / PASSWORD; it only grant/revoke/map/audit.

findings.red: A boolean overlay, env flag, or trustedPrecreated without the rest of the live-Sunset conjuncts could have been enough to punch through the product-database gate.
findings.green: Option without trustedPrecreated, without apply, with a password, with create-role, with non-owner session_user, with the wrong database, kind, location_key, role attributes, or a non-exact mapping fails closed. Env overlays and string 'true' do not enable the path.
